articles.headline: Why Spain are top of the world in both men's and women's games
articles.description: It's no coincidence that Spain are the first nation to hold both the men's and women's World Cups simultaneously. It's been a generation in the making.

articles.headline: World Cup musings: Argentina let down Messi; England have regressed
articles.description: Now that the dust has settled on the 2026 FIFA World Cup, what better time for Gabriele Marcotti to pause and reflect on what we've seen?

articles.headline: The players who played no minutes at the World Cup -- who were the unlucky few?
articles.description: The World Cup was a time to remember for most, for a handful of players though, their time at the tournament was merely sitting in the best seats in the house.

articles.headline: Mexico great Guillermo Ochoa retires after 22-year career
articles.description: Guillermo Ochoa, widely considered among the greatest Mexican goalkeepers in history, announced his retirement from elite soccer on Tuesday, bringing an end to a distinguished 22-year professional career.

articles.headline: World Cup final peaks at 60M viewers in North America
articles.description: A lot of things went right during this summer's World Cup, including record viewership numbers in North America for Spain's 1-0 win over Argentina in Sunday's final.
